ZiaVelo Saturday Group Ride

Las Cruces, NM · Road

ZiaVelo Saturday Group Ride is a road group ride in Las Cruces, NM. It rolls every Saturday at 8:15 am from Milagro Coffee y Espresso.

How we know

ZiaVelo's group rides page gives the Saturday no-drop ride (8:00 meet in late September) with nothing dated on it; New Mexico Cycling's group ride list, last updated Jan 23, 2026, also lists a Saturday ZiaVelo ride all year (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

For visitors

The club says anyone is welcome. A club member makes sure the group waits for riders going farther. Wind and heat change the pace through the year.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 18 to 19 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the ZiaVelo Saturday Group Ride group ride

A no-drop Saturday road ride, usually a 40 mile out and back toward the airport with regroups at Frontage Rd and Crawford Blvd and at Bowlin's Old West Trading Post. Some riders turn back there and some go on toward Corralitos Ranch. Other ZiaVelo rides run Sundays and Wednesdays.
